hints.en: The IQR rule: `q1 - 1.5 * iqr` and `q3 + 1.5 * iqr`.

hints.tr: Aykırı değerleri iki koşulu `|` ile birleştirip seçiyorsun; parantez şart.
hints.en: You select the outliers by combining two conditions with `|`; brackets are required.

hints.tr: Son satırda grup tablosunu `agg(["count", "mean"])` ile alıp `round(1)` uygula.
hints.en: For the last block take the group table with `agg(["count", "mean"])` and apply `round(1)`.

hints.tr:
Çözüm:

```python
sure = data["minutes"]
q1 = sure.quantile(0.25)
q3 = sure.quantile(0.75)
iqr = q3 - q1
low = q1 - 1.5 * iqr
high = q3 + 1.5 * iqr

print(sure[(sure < low) | (sure > high)].tolist())
print(round(sure.mean(), 2), sure.median())
print(data.groupby("team")["minutes"].agg(["count", "mean"]).round(1))
```
hints.en:
The solution:

```python
minutes = data["minutes"]
q1 = minutes.quantile(0.25)
q3 = minutes.quantile(0.75)
iqr = q3 - q1
low = q1 - 1.5 * iqr
high = q3 + 1.5 * iqr

print(minutes[(minutes < low) | (minutes > high)].tolist())
print(round(minutes.mean(), 2), minutes.median())
print(data.groupby("team")["minutes"].agg(["count", "mean"]).round(1))
```
